multilingual.query: Write a decision record in Markdown+
Convert this HTML document to Markdown+ with proper blocks and metadata
把這份 dev note 改成 Markdown+ format,記得每個 block 都要有 type 跟 status
幫我把這文件用 +md 整理一下

functional.name: Fresh write: Auth service dev note
functional.given: User provides topic 'Q2 Auth service 現況 + 已知 issues + Q3 action items',no source content
functional.when: Skill invoked with fresh_write input type
then: Output starts with single H1
Contains at least 3 top-level blocks (e.g. #current-state, #issues, #actions)
Each block has type / status / updated metadata
No `:::` fences anywhere
If any KPI mentioned, type:kpi with value + matching prose

functional.name: Rewrite markdown that contains ASCII directory tree
functional.given: Input markdown has H2 sections including one with a fenced code block containing ASCII tree (│ ├ └)
then: Tree appears in output inside ``` fence
Every line of the tree is preserved byte-for-byte (whitespace + box-drawing chars intact)
Tree is NOT collapsed into a paragraph
Containing block has type:diagram (or figure) with diagram-type:ascii-tree (or chart-type)
Block has a prose companion below the fence

functional.name: HTML input contains base64 image
then: Skill does NOT include the base64 in output
Skill EITHER writes a TODO marker pointing to external path, OR stops and asks the user
Output contains zero `data:` URIs or `base64,` substrings

functional.name: History/deprecated block with superseded-by
functional.given: User asks to add a #auth-v1 block describing deprecated v1, with #current-state describing v2
then: #auth-v1 has type:history AND visibility:collapsed AND superseded-by:current-state
#current-state is referenced and exists

functional.name: Install steps for mac/linux/windows
functional.given: Tutorial section has parallel install instructions for 3 OSes
then: Three sibling blocks share same variant-group: value
Each has distinct variant: value (mac/linux/windows)
Each contains a fenced code block with the OS-specific command verbatim

functional.name: Large table (>30 rows) gets externalized
functional.given: Source has a table with 50+ rows of sales data
then: Output block has data-source:./data/*.csv metadata
Inline table is replaced by schema summary + prose top-N observations
Block has type:table

functional.name: KPI block has value + matching prose
functional.given: Source mentions 'MRR is $1.2M, Q1 target was $1.5M, up 12% from last quarter'
then: Block has type:kpi
Metadata contains value:1.2M, target:1.5M, delta:+12%
Prose paragraph also mentions '1.2M' (consistent with metadata)
